subject: Bruno Guimaraes faces his old club Newcastle as Arteta still wants more
title: Bruno's return, Arteta wants more

lines.vo: A reported seventy-five million pounds, and Arteta says: not there yet.
lines.footage: Guimaraes press clip or match action, clean wide shot

lines.vo: Saturday at five-thirty, Bruno Guimaraes visits his old house: St James' Park.
lines.footage: St James' Park exterior, stadium wide shot

lines.vo: He scored thirty-one league goals for Newcastle, nine of them last season. They remember.
Now he is first choice at Arsenal, after a slow start.
Arteta wants more close-range goals. Apparently seventy-five million does not cover tap-ins.
He ranks near the top for ground duels, behind only Romeo Lavia.
lines.footage: duel and tackle clips, stat graphic

lines.vo: The twist? He has scored against Sunderland and Leeds. Arteta still wants more. Of course he does.
lines.footage: Guimaraes goal vs Sunderland and vs Leeds

lines.vo: Your mates will never guess this. News, betting tips and predictions at aboutfootball dot UK.

inserts.story: Setup: a clean-line midfielder in a red coat knocks on his old front door. Gag: a black-and-white fan opens it, holding his old shirt like a family photo. Twist: the fan asks him to wipe his feet.
inserts.characters: Guimaraes caricature, generic Newcastle fan caricature, door prop

inserts.story: Setup: a clean-line coach holds a tiny ruler against a goal and says closer. Gag: the midfielder steps a centimetre nearer, ball on the line. Twist: the coach asks for a smaller ruler.
inserts.characters: Arteta caricature, Guimaraes caricature, ruler prop

inserts.story: Setup: a price tag marked seventy-five floats beside the midfielder like a balloon. Gag: each goal ties on another balloon. Twist: the coach counts them and asks for one more.
inserts.characters: Arteta caricature, Guimaraes caricature, balloon and price tag props

facts_used: Arsenal signed Guimaraes for a reported 75 million pounds; Arteta says he is still not there (news 167, 170)
He faces Newcastle at St James' Park on Saturday 21 November, 5:30pm UK time (news 170)
Scored nine Premier League goals for Newcastle last season and 31 league goals in total for the club (news 170, background)
Now a first-choice midfielder after a slow start at Arsenal (news 167)
Arteta wants more close-range goals; Guimaraes ranks near the top for ground duels, behind only Romeo Lavia; he has scored against Sunderland and Leeds (news 167)
